title: Released CLASSIFY operation baseline and versioned expansion
description: Tally 0.3.3 publishes the first-release twelve-operation CLASSIFY inventory: classify.evaluate, classify.outcome.get, classify.apply.preview, classify.apply.run, classify.rule.save, classify.rule.validate, classify.rule.activate, classify.rule.retire, classify.feedback.record, classify.status, classify.abandon, and classify.cleanup. These identifiers and their 1.0 request/result/error semantics remain compatible. Later additive operations are permitted only through an explicit accepted versioned decision, published schema inventory, source-generated JSON registration, handler composition, compatibility tests, and release notes; an existing capability may not be merged away or silently changed.
